narrative.intro: Csi Aviation has $1.1B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Csi Aviation won 9 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $128M and obligations up 73.7% year over year. Csi Aviation’s obligations have grown sharply across recent years: $2.4M in FY21, $4.8M in FY22, $162M in FY23, $350M in FY24, $661M in FY25, and $1.1B in FY26. Department of Homeland Security is the largest buyer of Csi Aviation in FY2026 to date with $1.1B in obligations. Department of Defense has $1.7M in obligations and Department of Energy has $721K in obligations. All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services is the largest market for Csi Aviation in FY2026 to date with $1.1B in obligations, followed by Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation with $2.3M. The page notes that the listed award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values while the rest are contract obligations, and that current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date.
